name: SEATS
meaning: racers in a race at most: the game has 30 machines, and every per-seat table has 30 places

name: RACERS_MIN
meaning: the fewest racers of a race: one seat (the core refuses a race of none, and gives the game the racers beside the first)

name: NAME_SIZE
meaning: bytes of one player name's place in the window, the ending zero included

name: NAME_SHOWN
meaning: characters of a player name the results screens show: longer names are cut

name: RECORD
meaning: bytes of the game's control record: one seat's input for one step

name: INPUT_SLOT
meaning: bytes one seat's record takes in the input buffer (a 6-byte record in an 8-byte place)

name: RING_STEPS
meaning: steps the input buffer and the checksum ring keep: step s is at s & 1023

name: LAPS_MIN
meaning: the fewest laps the game takes: 0 is a free run, with no lap count

name: LAPS_MAX
meaning: the most laps the game takes: two digits, as its lap counter shows

name: CPU_LEVEL_MAX
meaning: the highest CPU level: 0 Novice, 1 Standard, 2 Expert, 3 Master

name: SETTING_MAX
meaning: the highest machine setting: 0 is all acceleration, 100 all top speed

name: FINISH_LIMIT_MAX
meaning: the longest a host may set between the first finish and the race's end for everyone, in seconds (0: no such end)

name: MINE_REGEN_MAX
meaning: the longest a host may set between a mine going off and its coming back, in milliseconds (0: a mine stays gone, the game's own way)

name: MINE_REGEN_STEP
meaning: the host's mine rule moves in steps of this many milliseconds: 50 ms is 3 steps of the game exactly

name: INPUT_DELAY
meaning: steps between a player's input and the step it is used in (decided: 2, never more)

name: MAX_UNTRACKED
meaning: memory ranges never rolled back, at most (the list at UNTRACKED)

name: IMAGE
meaning: the mod image's bytes: its routines run as native code, the bytes serve the words they read

name: CONTROL
meaning: the frame routine's control block: the words of group control

name: CHECKSUMS
meaning: the checksum ring: one word for each of the last 1024 steps

name: SMOOTH
meaning: the rivals' drawn offsets, which keep them steady through rollbacks

name: SMOOTH_GLOBALS
meaning: the smoothing's own counters, after the 30 rivals' places

name: NAMES
meaning: the player names: 30 places of NAME_SIZE bytes, seat order; an empty one shows the pilot's name

name: MONITORS
meaning: the rejoin hand-back monitors' state (monitors.py), the picture's only: +0 the step control comes back, +4 the pictures (0 not tried, 1 trying, 2 read, 3 not read), +36 the picture in the texture plus 1 (0 none)

name: MINES
meaning: mines that come back (sites_mines.py): +0 the state of the countdowns' block (0 not tried, 1 taken, 3 none), +4 its address in the main heap (0 none)

name: ICONS
meaning: tests: the rank icons' exclusion (rankicons.py): a word a racer, the drawn frames its icon was held back (the racer the HUD follows), then a word a racer at +120, the frames it was let through; counted only with IMAGE_LOGS

name: COURSE_NAME
meaning: a story stage's name, NAME_SIZE bytes with the ending zero, written by the core (protocol/courses.toml): the game's course name table points the stage's English entry here (COURSE_NAMES); the picture's only

name: RACE
meaning: the race block: what race to start (group race)

name: INPUTS
meaning: the input buffer: 1024 steps of 30 seats, INPUT_SLOT bytes each

name: INPUTS_END
meaning: the first address after the input buffer

name: SEAT_BLOCK
meaning: each seat's own stats and constants (a stat pack a seat): a byte a seat (its row is on), the seats' constants, the seats' rows

name: SEAT_BLOCK_SIZE
meaning: bytes of the seats' block

name: SEAT_CONSTANTS
meaning: the seats' constants: SEAT_CONSTANT bytes a seat, seat order

name: SEAT_CONSTANT
meaning: bytes of one seat's constants: +0 the dash plate's A, +4 its B, +8 a boost frame's energy use, +12 the boost length's base (floats), +16 the speed cap (a double), +24 the boost length's scale, +28 the machine setting's curve (SEAT_CURVE)

name: SEAT_DASH_BASE
meaning: in a seat's constants: the dash plate's A (a float)

name: SEAT_DASH_SCALE
meaning: in a seat's constants: the dash plate's B (a float)

name: SEAT_ENERGY_USE
meaning: in a seat's constants: a boost frame's energy use (a float)

name: SEAT_SPEED_CAP
meaning: in a seat's constants: the speed cap (a double)

name: SEAT_BOOST_BASE
meaning: in a seat's constants: the boost length's base (a float): an energy boost lasts int(base + scale x boost duration) frames

name: SEAT_BOOST_SCALE
meaning: in a seat's constants: the boost length's scale (a float)

name: SEAT_CURVE
meaning: in a seat's constants: the machine setting's curve (sites_curve.py), a float a slot in slot order from here, its one double (AccelGain) at SEAT_CURVE_DOUBLE

name: SEAT_CURVE_DOUBLE
meaning: in a seat's constants: the machine setting's acceleration gain (a double)

name: SEAT_SETTING
meaning: the constants of the seat whose machine setting runs (fn_1_22B10 called by fn_1_331EC, sites_curve.py), 0 at every other time: written before that call and cleared after it

name: SEAT_ROWS
meaning: the seats' rows: a car data block a seat, seat order, read in place of the table's when the seat's byte is not 0

name: IMAGE_LIMIT
meaning: the mod image ends before this address

name: WINDOW
meaning: the mod's data window begins here: no guest memory is behind it

name: WINDOW_END
meaning: the first address after the mod's data window

name: IMAGE_HOOK
meaning: the image's word that is the network hook where the image is in real memory (the JIT reference): a blr the emulator's hook stands on

name: MODE
meaning: what the game was started for: 0 a plain start, 1 a race (a match file, or a replay played as the race)

name: PRELOAD
meaning: the results screen's pictures read before the race: +0 state (2 read, 3 not read), three pairs (bitmap group, the packed file's address), +28 loads served from memory, +32 the main heap's largest free block when it was tried

name: END_OFFICIAL
meaning: the race's end, held until it is official: set by the core, every step below this one ran, or runs in this frame, with the official inputs (0: never said)

name: END_ASKED
meaning: set by the image: 1, the race looks over on steps not yet official; the core's next frame checks them, runs no new step, and clears it

name: END_OVER
meaning: set by the image: 1, its race-over test said the race is over: the core predicts no step from here

name: HANDBACK
meaning: set by the core, for the picture only: steps left until a returning seat's player drives it again, down to 0 at that step (0: no hand-back)

name: FINISH_KIND
meaning: set by the image, for the picture only: what the local machine is at the last step boundary looked at, 0 racing, 1 finished, 2 out

name: FINISH_END
meaning: set by the image, for the picture only: the step at which the local racer's finish countdown reaches 0

name: FINISH_COUNT
meaning: set by the image: what the picture reads in place of the game's finish countdown, the local racer's (the game's own while the local machine races)

name: RESULTS_KEEP
meaning: set by the core, for the picture only: not 0, the results' cameras follow the local seat whatever it is (a spectator's game)

name: RESULTS_CAMERA
meaning: set by the image at the results' start and when it moves the results' cameras during them (follow.py results_watch), for the log only: 0x80000000, why the racer (follow.py RC_*) << 8, the racer the results' cameras follow; the core logs it and writes 0

name: DRAW_ASK
meaning: set by the image: 1 when a race frame's drawing is about to begin, 2 when it has ended; each store is a call to the core, which times the drawing and answers in DRAW_SKIP

name: DRAW_SKIP
meaning: set by the core when the image asks: not 0, this frame draws nothing and the next frame's begin copies no picture (the last one shown again); cleared at the next frame tick

name: TRUE_ASPECT
meaning: set by the core, for the picture only: 0, the game's own Wide Screen; a float's bits, true widescreen at that aspect (the race view keeps the whole vertical view; the aspect getter gives it)

name: SIM_GENERATOR
meaning: the simulation's own generator word (sites_generator.py): seeded by the image before every step of a race with RACE_SIM_GENERATOR 1 from the step and the CPU seed, stepped by the race's own draws only (the computer drivers' scripted driver, the hazard objects); no rollback puts it back

name: SIM_GENERATOR_SHIFT
meaning: set by the image: what the race's draws add to the executable's generator's address, 0 (the stock word 0x801A63C0) or SIM_GENERATOR - 0x801A63C0

name: SPEC_MODE
meaning: set by the image, for the picture only: what the spectator follows with, 0 automatic shots, 1 the course's cameras, 2 to 5 a manual shot, 6 the chase camera behind the watched racer

name: SPEC_HEIGHT
meaning: set by the image, for the picture only: the spectator's camera height, a manual shot's variant or the chase camera's view less 1

name: SPEC_CHANGE
meaning: set by the image, for the picture only: the step, plus 1, in which the spectator's last choice sets its shot up, run for the first time or again

name: SPEC_PENDING
meaning: set by the image: 1 from a spectator's choice on a frame's entry until that frame's first step takes it

name: SPEC_LOGGED
meaning: tests: where the spectator's log at SPEC_LOG takes its next entry

name: VIEW_SCRATCH
meaning: two words the racing view's helper keeps two registers in while it reads the input rows

name: SPEC_ASKED
meaning: set by the image, for the picture only: the mode the spectator's D-pad down last asked for; the next press takes the one after it

name: IMAGE_LOGS
meaning: tests: set by the core in a game whose launch file asks for a dump; not 0, the image keeps its three logs (SPEC_LOG, GENERATOR_LOG, SMOOTH_LOG); a players' game writes none of them

name: SPEC_STEP
meaning: set by the image, for the picture only: 1 from the spectator's routine of a step until the task manager's pass of that step reaches the cameras' list, where the image looks again at who is out

name: HFR_DRAWING
meaning: reserved, 0: nothing writes or reads it (the emulator draws the pictures between two steps, not the game)

name: SPEC_LOG
meaning: tests: the spectator's log, SPEC_LOG_ENTRIES entries of 8 bytes, round when full, one a displayed frame while spectating (the step, the racer and mode chosen, what the cameras hold)

name: SPEC_LOG_ENTRIES
meaning: tests: entries of 8 bytes the spectator's log at SPEC_LOG holds before it goes round

name: GENERATOR_LOG
meaning: tests: the race's two generator words after every step, 8 bytes at step & (GENERATOR_LOG_STEPS - 1): the executable's, then the effects'

name: GENERATOR_LOG_STEPS
meaning: tests: steps the generator log holds

name: SMOOTH_LOG
meaning: tests: the rivals' smoothing log, 8 bytes at frame & (SMOOTH_LOG_FRAMES - 1): the step, the seat, the frame's flags, the part of the offset that was cut and the square of a body's distance to its shadow (a float's upper half each)

name: SMOOTH_LOG_FRAMES
meaning: tests: displayed race frames the smoothing log holds

name: SMOOTH_FRAMES
meaning: the smoothing's count of displayed race frames: the log's place of the last frame

name: EFFECTS
meaning: tests: the effects' counters (sites_effects.py): how far a rival's effects were drawn from its body before and after they were moved with it

name: HOSTCALLS
meaning: host calls: a call to one of these addresses leaves the game's code for the host program

name: HOST_NET
meaning: host call: the network hook, before every step and in every pass of the start gate

name: HOST_TICK
meaning: host call: every game frame of a race or replay start

name: HOST_LINKED
meaning: host call: main.rel is linked and none of its code has run

name: HOST_HFR
meaning: host call: the drawn frames between two steps (high refresh rate), from fn_1_37AA8's draw half

name: HOSTCALLS_END
meaning: the first address after the four host calls

name: EXTRA_STEPS
meaning: steps the frame routine runs in this displayed frame after the first; counts down

name: RESIMULATING
meaning: 1 while the extra steps run

name: RESIM_TICKS
meaning: set by the image: time base ticks the last frame's extra steps took

name: SOUND_DROPPED
meaning: counter: sound commands dropped because their step had been simulated before

name: SOUND_COMMANDS
meaning: counter: sound commands of the whole run

name: GO
meaning: the relay's go: 1 releases the race-start gate

name: READY
meaning: set by the game when it holds at the race-start gate

name: GATE_ON
meaning: 1: the game holds at the race start until GO

name: SESSION
meaning: 1 in a network session

name: RUNNING
meaning: 1 once the race runs by steps (from the relay's go)

name: STEP
meaning: the step about to run, counted from the relay's go

name: DESYNCS
meaning: counter: steps whose checksum differed from another game's

name: FAILED
meaning: 1 when the session failed

name: ROLLBACKS
meaning: counter: rollbacks

name: MAX_DEPTH
meaning: the deepest rollback so far, in steps

name: RESIM_STEPS
meaning: counter: steps simulated again after a rollback

name: RTT_TENTHS
meaning: the round trip to the relay, in tenths of a millisecond

name: CATCH_UPS
meaning: counter: steps added to catch up with the relay's clock

name: WATCHED_PAGES
meaning: memory pages the undo log compares at every step

name: LATE_PAGES
meaning: pages first seen changing after the learning steps

name: DISPLAYED_FRAMES
meaning: counter: displayed race frames

name: TIME_FRAME
meaning: timing: microseconds in the network hook per displayed frame, averaged

name: TIME_TRACK
meaning: timing: microseconds comparing memory per displayed frame, averaged

name: TIME_RESTORE
meaning: timing: microseconds putting memory back per displayed frame, averaged

name: BLOCKS_PER_FRAME
meaning: 32-byte blocks the undo log kept per displayed frame, averaged

name: VERIFY_CHECKSUMS
meaning: tests: 1 makes the image compute the checksum too

name: CHECKSUM_DIFFERENCES
meaning: tests: steps where the image's checksum and the host's differed

name: TICKS_PER_EXTRA_STEP
meaning: time base ticks an extra step took, averaged

name: FINAL_STEPS
meaning: steps below this ran with the official inputs: they are final

name: SPECTATE_FRAMES
meaning: displayed frames the local racer has been out: at 180 the camera goes to the leader

name: FORCE_ROLLBACK
meaning: tests: every N displayed race frames, roll back D steps (N << 16 | D)

name: BOOST_FROM_START
meaning: 1: boosting is allowed on the first lap

name: PAINT_REPORT
meaning: tests: machines repainted, then skipped, then the last one skipped and why

name: OTHER_SOUNDS
meaning: the loudness of other racers' own sounds, of 256, plus 1

name: UNTRACKED
meaning: set by the image: the count of memory ranges never rolled back, then their start and end

name: EXIT_REQUEST
meaning: 1: the player is done with the results and the game is to stop

name: PRESS_A
meaning: 1: the image presses A on port 0 for one frame, then writes 0 (the results' leave in time; the HUD pass past a racing racer's first results page)

name: WATCH_AS_RACE
meaning: 1 while a replay is watched as the race: the D-pad moves the seat the camera follows

name: SLOT
meaning: the seat routines' slot in the image: this game's seat and what goes with it

name: SLOT_SEAT
meaning: this game's seat

name: SLOT_OFF
meaning: 1 turns the seat routines off

name: SLOT_UNIFORM
meaning: 1: every seat is treated alike

name: SLOT_PLAYERS
meaning: the seats players hold: bit i is seat i

name: SLOT_DELAY
meaning: the input delay of this race, in steps

name: RACE_COURSE
meaning: the course's number

name: RACE_MACHINE0
meaning: seat 0's machine

name: RACE_OPPONENTS
meaning: the racers less one

name: RACE_LAPS
meaning: the laps

name: RACE_TYPE
meaning: the race type: 6 a race by laps, 3 a free run

name: RACE_SHUFFLE
meaning: the value of the executable's generator up to the race: it deals the CPUs their machines

name: RACE_CPUSEED
meaning: the CPUs' seed for this race

name: RACE_MACHINES
meaning: the 30 seats' machines, a byte each, seat 0 first

name: RACE_GRID_ON
meaning: the start grid's word: 1, the race names its grid (RACE_GRID); 0, the game's own sort, every race and recording without one

name: RACE_GRID
meaning: the start grid: the seat of each of the 30 slots, a byte each, pole first

name: RACE_CPULEVEL
meaning: the host's rule: the CPU level, 0 to 3

name: RACE_BOOST
meaning: the host's rule: boosting from the start

name: RACE_RESTORE
meaning: the host's rule: a machine that falls or is wrecked is put back

name: RACE_SETTINGS
meaning: every seat's machine setting, a byte each

name: RACE_FINISH_LIMIT
meaning: the host's rule: the steps after the first finish at which the race ends for everyone (0: no such end)

name: RACE_FLOW
meaning: the race's flow: 1, out by the game's own verdict and the race waits for player seats only; 0, a recording made before

name: RACE_MINE_REGEN
meaning: the host's rule: the steps after which a mine that went off comes back (0: it stays gone, the game's own way)

name: RACE_RUBBER_BAND_ON
meaning: the rubber band: 1, the CPU drivers pace against the player seats (the game's own way, every recording made before 0.4.0); 0, every driver at its own pace (every race and practice from 0.4.0; the core writes it, a future lobby rule could set it from the server)

name: RACE_SIM_GENERATOR
meaning: the simulation's own generator: 1, the race's draws take SIM_GENERATOR (every race and practice from this build); 0, the executable's 0x801A63C0, shared with the effects and cameras (every recording made before)

name: RACE_CUSTOM
meaning: the seats' custom machines: 30 entries of 32 bytes (a used word, three part entries, the pilot)

name: RACE_SIZE
meaning: bytes of the race block

name: MAIN_REL
meaning: where main.rel's header is in every boot (the pin makes it so)

name: MAIN_REL_ID
meaning: main.rel's module number, the first word of its header

name: REL_TEXT
meaning: main.rel's code (.text)

name: REL_TEXT_SIZE
meaning: bytes of main.rel's code

name: REL_DATA
meaning: main.rel's data (.data)

name: REL_RODATA
meaning: main.rel's constants (.rodata), which no step writes

name: REL_BSS
meaning: main.rel's zeroed data (.bss), where the race's state is

name: RAM
meaning: main memory's first guest address

name: RETAIL_RAM_SIZE
meaning: bytes of main memory: the console's 24 MiB

name: MODULE_LIST
meaning: the system's list of linked modules: its first entry is main.rel

name: LOCKED_CACHE
meaning: the locked cache's first guest address (the console's 16 KiB scratch the game locks in its data cache; the native module's second window): the collision work area and the maths area live there

name: DOL_RNG
meaning: the executable's random generator: it deals the CPUs their machines, and a rollback puts it back

name: EFFECTS_RNG
meaning: the effects' random generator, in main.rel's data: the effects and the TV cameras' type pick draw from it, and a rollback puts it back

name: BOOST_ENERGY_USE
meaning: the energy a boost costs a frame, times the usage factor (a float, the game's 1/6): read by fn_1_26F34 only; a stat pack's constant

name: SPEED_CAP
meaning: the speed above which the momentum is cut to a near stop (a double, the game's 9990 km/h): read by fn_1_294D0 only; a stat pack's constant

name: STATE_END
meaning: the simulation's memory ends here; the display buffers follow

name: SOUND_QUEUE
meaning: the address of the game's sound command queue (main.dol r13 - 0x7740; every sound start goes through fn_80067898): +0x240 64 commands, +0x441 the waiting, +0x443 the next place

name: BOOT_TIME
meaning: the system time the game's OS took from the real-time clock when it booted: 64 bits (two words), in ticks of the time base

name: IDLE_GPU_SYNC
meaning: a wait the game spins in, counted as idle time: for the picture to be drawn

name: IDLE_DISC_READ
meaning: a wait counted as idle time: the executable's disc read

name: IDLE_LOAD_QUEUE
meaning: a wait counted as idle time: main.rel's wait for its load queue

name: IDLE_OS
meaning: the operating system's idle loop: native code spins in it unless the emulator is told (its own compiler skips the loop by itself)

name: REFERENCE_RAM_SIZE
meaning: bytes of emulated main memory in the reference configuration (the fork's 32 MiB): the image is in real memory above the retail 24 MiB

name: DOL_FILE_OFFSETS
meaning: the executable file's header: where its 18 sections' file offsets begin (7 text, then 11 data; a word each)

name: DOL_FILE_ADDRESSES
meaning: the executable file's header: where the sections' guest addresses begin

name: DOL_FILE_SIZES
meaning: the executable file's header: where the sections' sizes begin

name: DOL_FILE_SECTIONS
meaning: sections an executable file has room for: 7 of code and 11 of data

name: DOL_FILE_HEADER_SIZE
meaning: bytes of the executable file's header: a file shorter than this is none

name: GAME_MODE
meaning: the game's mode word (16 bits)

name: GAME_SUBMODE
meaning: the game's sub-mode word (16 bits): which screen of the mode it is in

name: MODE_REQUEST
meaning: the mode the game goes to at its next frame (16 bits; MODE_NONE: none asked for): its mode machine, main.rel fn_1_ECC, leaves the old mode and enters this one

name: SUBMODE_REQUEST
meaning: the sub-mode the game goes to at its next frame (16 bits; MODE_NONE: none asked for)

name: MODE_NONE
meaning: a mode or sub-mode word that names none: no screen entered yet, nothing asked for

name: MODE_OPTION
meaning: the game's mode word in its Options (MD_OPTION)

name: MODE_TITLE
meaning: the game's mode word at the title (MD_TITLE)

name: SUBMODE_TITLE_DEMO
meaning: the title's sub-mode a boot stands in once its memory card sequence is over: Press Start over the demonstration race (SMD_TITLE_DEMO)

name: SUBMODE_OPTION_MENU
meaning: Options' first menu: Controller, Memory Card, Screen Mode (SMD_OPTION_MENU); the Options module's start asks for it

name: SUBMODE_OPTION_SAVE
meaning: Options writing the save to the memory card after a changed screen (SMD_OPTION_SAVE_WAIT)

name: SUBMODE_OPTION_CONTROLLER
meaning: Options' controller menu: Calibration, Customize, Controller Rumble (SMD_OPTION_CTRL_MENU); B asks for SUBMODE_OPTION_MENU

name: SAVE_DEFAULTS_SET
meaning: the executable's byte the title sets once it has put the save's defaults in memory (before its memory card sequence); while it is 0 the title's exit puts them there, over what was loaded

name: GAME_PASSES
meaning: the executable's count of unpaused passes of the main loop: the drawn frames between two steps blend only from one pass to the next

name: PHASE
meaning: the phase of the game's race mode (16 bits)

name: PHASE_RACE
meaning: the phase word while the race runs

name: INTRO_COUNTDOWN
meaning: the course intro's countdown (phase 0x27, fn_1_391F0): fields left, counted down to 0; at 1 the closing fade is done and the start gate holds

name: INTRO_CUT
meaning: what the game's own skip of the course intro (player 1's A or START) cuts its countdown to when it is above: the closing fade's fields

name: INTRO_FADE
meaning: main.rel's fade's state byte (fn_1_4C10 reads it); its bit 0: a fade runs, and the course intro's skip is not taken (read in the linked code of a dump, run cam4g-dual-core-race300-on-1)

name: HUD_PARTS
meaning: the HUD part mask, a word a viewport (viewport 0 first): read by drawing only; bit 0x00800000 is the game's map picture (fn_1_79654), which our course map replaces

name: MAP_CAMERAS
meaning: the game's map cameras, 0x1C bytes a course (field of view, eye, the point it looks at), 46 courses: the game's map picture and its markers are drawn through them (fn_1_7926C)

name: COURSE_NAMES
meaning: the game's course name table: COURSE_NAME_ENTRY bytes a course by its number, a pointer a language (English first, then German, French, Spanish, Italian, Japanese); every story stage's English entry points at "---" (37 at "Sonic Oval"); drawn by the course intro's title card and the screens that name a course, read by no step

name: COURSE_NAME_ENTRY
meaning: bytes of one course's entry in the course name table (COURSE_NAMES): six pointers

name: INTRO_SKIP_ON
meaning: fn_1_EB200's first word: 0 lets the course intro's skip be taken whatever INTRO_SKIP_STATE says

name: INTRO_SKIP_STATE
meaning: fn_1_EB200's state word: 0xE, 0xF or 0x10 refuse the course intro's skip while INTRO_SKIP_ON is not 0 (what the states are is not known)

name: MODE_GAME
meaning: the game's mode word in a race (MD_GAME)

name: LOAD_QUEUED
meaning: the game's queue of file preloads: how many entries were queued so far (the ring's next free place)

name: LOAD_DONE
meaning: the game's queue of file preloads: how many entries are done (the one in progress)

name: LOAD_QUEUE
meaning: the game's queue of file preloads: a ring of 512 entries of 12 bytes (kind, the file's number in the disc's file table, an argument)

name: DISC_TABLE
meaning: the system's word that points at the disc's file table in memory: entries of 12 bytes, the first holding their count at +8, a file's entry its length at +8 (its first byte 0)

name: RACE_CLOCK
meaning: the game's race clock: 0 through the intro and the countdown, then one more after every step of the race and the results; rolled back with the race, not in the checksum

name: PAD_RECORD
meaning: port 0's control record, as the game's input layer made it

name: SCREEN_OPTION
meaning: the game's screen option: 0 normal, 1 or 2 wide screen

name: OPTION_BINDINGS
meaning: the player's button settings, as the game's input layer reads them: 4 ports of 0x54 bytes, each three sets (a set for a kind of controller) of nine bindings

name: OPTION_STICK_GATE
meaning: the player's stick calibration: 4 ports of 8 corner points, each x and y as signed bytes

name: OPTION_DEAD_ZONES
meaning: the player's stick dead zones: 4 ports of 2 bytes (across, up), 0 to 50; the input layer divides by 100 less the dead zone

name: OPTION_WHEEL_RANGE
meaning: the player's steering wheel range: 4 ports of 2 bytes (to the right, to the left)

name: OPTION_WHEEL_PLAY
meaning: the player's steering wheel play: 4 ports of 2 bytes, 0 to 20

name: OPTION_SCHEME
meaning: the player's control scheme: a byte a port, 0 or 1; the machine's task reads it only for a steering wheel

name: GAME_OPTIONS
meaning: the pointer to the game's options record (main.rel fn_1_FA4C0 and fn_1_FA450 read and write it)

name: SAVED_VIEW
meaning: in the options record: the chase camera's saved view, which a camera record's set-up takes (fn_1_8D08, one viewport, not the game's replay) and the chase camera writes back from its record (main.rel 0x9FC4)

name: CHASE_RECORD
meaning: the pointer to the chase camera records, 0x1FC bytes each, viewport 0's first: +0x2 the machine it follows

name: CHASE_VIEW
meaning: in a chase camera record: its view (fn_1_715C writes it, fn_1_ABAC changes it by the camera button: 0 to 3 in a race, 1 to 3 in ours, raceview.py; 5 while the followed machine is out)

name: GAME_ID
meaning: the disc this is for: F-Zero GX, NTSC-U
